brief: UBS's monthly Macro Equity Navigator argues AI positioning has cleaned up after a second unwind this year, but is not yet washed out. The crowding spread between its AI Winners and Ex-AI 400 baskets has fallen to February levels, and the derating now looks overly pessimistic on AI fundamentals, skewing risk-reward to the upside, though sentiment stays fragile. Hyperscalers are UBS's preferred defensive AI holding on stronger cash flow and balance sheets, while Neoclouds+ carries the leverage and buildout risk. The US broadening trade has leaned on AI weakness, leaving pockets like Consumer Staples, with weak earnings revisions, vulnerable to a correction. Keith Parker's top 2027 trade is long Health Care over Staples. China draws diversifier interest, but CSI 300 earnings revisions versus the S&P 500 sit at multi-year lows, needing policy support and property stabilization to recover. In Europe, the Stoxx 600 is making new highs, up 9pp on the S&P 500 and only about 11% AI-exposed, even as European Banks earnings revisions dropped sharply on a softer Q3. UBS still expects a bank re-rating through 2027 on valuations and lending growth. It also flags an energy-to-metals rotation and a UK domestics rally since the summer's PM change.
